title: Company Jobs Feed
description: Live, open jobs from companies' own hiring systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Personio, Pinpoint or Gem when you name the account, subdomain or vanity) via official public APIs. Give companies (names, domains or board URLs) and/or explicit boards, or search the verified starter list. Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are not discovered.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Company names, domains (ramp.com) or board URLs (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir). Seeded companies and board URLs resolve for free; others use discovery (see below). Max 200.

boards.title: Boards (explicit)
boards.description: Exact boards: [{"ats":"greenhouse|lever|ashby|personio|pinpoint|gem","slug":"..."}], or strings like "ashby:ramp", "personio:acme", "pinpoint:acme", "gem:acme" or board URLs. A Personio, Pinpoint or Gem slug is the account, subdomain or vanity you name, not a discovered name. Optional company/domain per board. Max 500.

useSeedList.title: Scan the verified starter list
useSeedList.description: Add every board from the shipped starter list (135 verified company boards) so you can search them without bringing your own list. Each board is billed as one board scanned.

discover.title: Discover boards for unknown companies
discover.description: For a company that is not a board URL or in the starter list: read up to 3 pages of its own website (only where robots.txt allows) for links to Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby, then try up to 6 slug probes on those documented APIs. Personio, Pinpoint and Gem are never discovered; pass personio:{account}, pinpoint:{subdomain} or gem:{vanity}. Results are cached for 30 days; cached lookups are free.

titleIncludes.title: Title includes (any)
titleIncludes.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive, whole words: "engineer" does not match "Engineering").

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes (any)
titleExcludes.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words.

descriptionIncludes.title: Description includes (any)
descriptionIncludes.description: Keep jobs whose title or scrubbed description contains any of these whole words or phrases (case-insensitive). "avionics" matches a posting that says avionics in the body even when the title is Electrical Technician. Description text is fetched for the match. It is returned on the row only when includeDescription is text. Pinpoint and Gem have no description text, so only the title can match there.

titleRegex.title: Title regex
titleRegex.description: Optional case-insensitive regular expression the title must match (max 200 characters, no nested quantifiers).

locations.title: Locations (any)
locations.description: Substring match on the job's location text, e.g. "new york", "berlin", "Baltimore MD". US state names and postal codes match both ways (Florida and FL, Maryland and MD). Metro aliases include NYC, SF / San Francisco, LA / Los Angeles, DC / Washington, Tampa / Tampa Bay, and Baltimore / BWI. "remote" also matches jobs the ATS flags as remote.

countries.title: Countries (ISO-2, any)
countries.description: ISO-2 codes like US, DE, GB. Uses the ATS's structured country where it has one (Lever, Ashby), otherwise a small place-name list on the location text (country_basis says which). Jobs with no country information are dropped when this is set.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: only = remote jobs only; exclude = drop remote jobs. Uses the ATS's remote flag where present, otherwise the location text (remote_basis says which).

companyFilter.title: Company name contains (any)
companyFilter.description: Keep only jobs whose company name or board slug contains any of these (useful with the starter list).

departments.title: Departments / teams (any)
departments.description: Substring match on department or team, e.g. "engineering", "sales".

employmentTypes.title: Employment types (any)
employmentTypes.description: Substring match on employment type, e.g. "full time", "contract", "intern".

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs whose ATS publish date (posted_at) is at most this many days ago. Jobs without a publish date are dropped unless 'Include unknown posted date' is on.

includeUnknownPostedDate.title: Include unknown posted date
includeUnknownPostedDate.description: With 'Posted within', also keep jobs whose ATS gives no publish date.

maxAgeDays.title: Max age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Drop jobs older than this. Age = now − posted_at, or now − first_seen_at when the ATS has no date (age_basis).

hasSalary.title: Only jobs with published pay
hasSalary.description: Keep only jobs where the ATS publishes compensation (Ashby, some Lever boards, Personio only when that company's XML includes a salary element, and Pinpoint when compensation_visible is not false). Gem rows have no compensation.

excludeStale.title: Exclude stale signals
excludeStale.description: Drop jobs flagged long_open (older than 'Long-open threshold') or reposted. These are heuristics, not proof either way.

longOpenDays.title: Long-open threshold (days)
longOpenDays.description: A job older than this is flagged long_open.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed jobs
onlyNew.description: Return only jobs that are new or changed since the last tracked run with the same state store (plus free 'closed' rows). The first run is the baseline: everything is new.

trackChanges.title: Track history
trackChanges.description: Keep per-board history (first_seen_at, last_seen_at, closed and repost detection) in a named key-value store in your account. Turn off to store nothing; history fields then describe this run only.

emitClosed.title: Emit closed rows
emitClosed.description: When tracking, emit one free row (change: closed) for each job that was open last run and is gone from a complete fetch now.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store for history and the discovery cache. Use a different name per saved search/monitor.

dedupe.title: De-duplication
dedupe.description: exact = one row per ats+board+job id; role = also merge one board's rows with the same title + department into one row listing all locations (merged rows are free); none = no de-duplication. Every row carries a fingerprint and duplicate_of; nothing is silently dropped across boards.

includeDescription.title: Description
includeDescription.description: text = plain-text job description (up to 20,000 characters) for Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Personio. Pinpoint and Gem rows stay empty and link to the employer's listing.

scrubPII.title: Scrub e-mails and phone numbers
scrubPII.description: Remove e-mail addresses and phone numbers (e.g. recruiter contacts) from descriptions.

confirmOpen.title: Re-check each job (detail endpoint)
confirmOpen.description: detail = re-fetch each emitted job from the ATS's documented per-job endpoint (Greenhouse, Lever; Ashby, Personio, Pinpoint and Gem have none, so those rows stay detail_not_supported and are not re-fetched). A 404 marks it closed. $0.29 per 1,000 re-checks; off by default because the board listing is already the employer's live list.

maxOpenChecks.title: Max re-checks
maxOpenChecks.description: Cap on detail re-checks per run.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Stop after this many job rows (the main cost driver: $0.99 per 1,000).

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max jobs read per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Safety cap on postings read from one board. A truncated board skips closed detection.
